dimension_a_pseudo.title: Step 2 extracts command/subCommand fields that are not present in §2.2 envelope
dimension_a_pseudo.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-33.pseudo:19 — Step 2 reads: 'keep phoneNumber, adminUserId, command, subCommand from envelope.' The §2.2 envelope (contracts.md §2.2) does not include command or subCommand fields — those were pre-envelope legacy fields. The Extract Command Data jsCode (WF-33.md:47) also extracts input.command and input.subCommand. These may be present as pass-through keys at runtime but are not part of the formal §2.2 shape.
dimension_a_pseudo.recommended_action: Update Step 2 prose to only reference fields defined in §2.2: 'keep phoneNumber, adminUserId from envelope (commandType is APPROVE_PAYMENT).' Also update the Extract Command Data jsCode comment block in the .md to reflect the §2.2 envelope fields — or confirm command/subCommand are harmless extras and note them as legacy pass-through.

dimension_a_pseudo.title: Step 3 pseudo says payment status = 'approved' but .md SQL sets status = 'verified'
dimension_a_pseudo.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-33.pseudo:20 — 'UPDATE chinmay_astro.payments SET status=\'approved\'...'; docs/pseudocode/WF-33.md:71 — actual SQL sets 'status = \'verified\''. This is a pre-existing pseudo↔md drift (not introduced this sprint) but is visible in the current state.
dimension_a_pseudo.recommended_action: Update pseudo Step 3 to use status='verified' to match actual SQL. (Pre-existing drift, Minor severity.)

dimension_b_drift.title: Extract Command Data jsCode: adminUserId set to input.channelId (stale pre-envelope mapping)
dimension_b_drift.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-33.md:47 — jsCode: 'adminUserId: input.channelId' — maps channelId to adminUserId. The §2.2 envelope emits adminUserId as a first-class field (contracts.md §2.2: 'adminUserId | Slack U-ID string | required'). The Extract Command Data node should read input.adminUserId directly. Using input.channelId is the pre-envelope bug pattern (TD-DRIFT-017's sibling — the field mapping that caused verified_by to receive the wrong value). The pseudo (Step 2, Step 3) says 'adminUserId from envelope' but the .md jsCode reads channelId instead.
dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: Update Extract Command Data jsCode to read 'adminUserId: input.adminUserId' (not input.channelId). This aligns .md with pseudo Step 2 and with §2.2 contract. Note: the Update Payment Status queryReplacement correctly references $("Extract Command Data").item.json.adminUserId — so fixing the Extract node source is sufficient to propagate the correct Slack user ID downstream. (TD-DRIFT-017 concerns verified_by column semantics and is out of scope per design.md §1.5 — but the field mapping error in Extract Command Data is a separate, in-scope contract conformance issue: the .md does not read the §2.2 envelope field adminUserId as documented in pseudo Step 2.)

dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: Update WF-33.pseudo Step 9 messageText to match the actual .md jsCode: '✅ Payment approved for <user.name> (<user.phone_number>). User notified via WhatsApp; consultation is now active.' The longer version references DOB/TOB/Place which are not in the §2.2 envelope — it is unreachable without a separate SELECT.

questions_for_human: Dimension B — Extract Command Data stale adminUserId mapping: the .md jsCode sets adminUserId: input.channelId (not input.adminUserId). This is the pre-envelope mapping that was never updated when WF-10 began emitting adminUserId as a first-class envelope field. This is distinct from TD-DRIFT-017 (which concerns the verified_by DB column semantics). Should fixing adminUserId: input.channelId → input.adminUserId in the Extract Command Data jsCode be treated as in-scope for Phase 1 (it is a direct contract conformance defect — the .md does not consume the §2.2 envelope field as documented), or should it also be parked to Phase 2 alongside TD-DRIFT-017? If parked, the pseudo Step 2 description ('keep phoneNumber, adminUserId...from envelope') becomes misleading documentation.
